about: The Game Corner's item hub (the owner's request of 2026-10-31; docs/owner-decisions.md 30-31): every item of the RARE GOODS at its price, unchanged (tools/mp/gen_rare_goods.py), and the items found elsewhere in the game at the owner's approved prices (2026-10-31, "yes approve"). One row per item: its kind and, for a new item, its coins. tools/mp/gen_item_hub.py writes the lists and the price table.
